read_record.canonical: Strictly increasing node IDs, including absent and off-path interior resources; absence has version zero

policy_u64: exclusive_net_id in bits 0..31 (UINT32_MAX means unrestricted), full die membership in bits 32..39, forbidden in bit 40, all higher bits zero
graph: Immutable CSR: node_count+1 u64 offsets, arc_count u64 arcs encoding destination:u32 and pip_key:u32; each adjacency sorted by destination then pip

authority.owner: lowest set bit of immutable full membership mask
authority.hash: (node * 2654435761 modulo 2^32) & (shard_capacity - 1), linear probing within owner's segment
authority.hash_capacity: power of two; stale-session slots are empty; current-session zero-occupancy entries remain versioned tombstones
authority.identity: One active slot per net ID; a slot binds its net ID for the session
authority.membership: One tree entry per (net,node), linked by both net and resource; occupancy equals exact membership count
authority.reset: Strictly newer session resets control and lazily invalidates old resource/tree/net tags
authority.revision: Initialize sets zero; accepted start/proposal/ripup/negotiate increments once, including accepted no-op mutations; validate/query leave it unchanged
authority.generation: Start sets one; proposal/ripup increments only when net tree changes
authority.versions: Start/insert/ripup increments affected resource version; negotiate increments overused resource version only when positive history increment applies
authority.cost: 1 + history + present * occupancy for a new net-node membership; reject arithmetic reaching reserved UINT64_MAX
authority.atomicity: Stage all branches and metadata in external journal, preflight delta capacity, then publish under exclusive disjoint-buffer ownership; every rejection preserves resource/tree/net/control bytes
authority.deltas: All changed resources, including interiors; order follows staged resource writes, recipients may filter boundary nodes without changing owner values

interfaces.control: ap_ctrl_chain plus explicit AXI-Lite for all 27 arguments

scope_limits: Negotiated PathFinder overuse is intentionally allowed; this is not a strict distributed capacity-grant protocol
Caller must provide every search read and preserve immutable graph buffers during each launch
Single authority master and logical owner segments do not prove physical per-owner bank placement
No concurrent DMA or crash-atomicity claim
Generation rejection can be stronger than structural tree equality after ABA; native-model equivalence assumes one outstanding proposal per net
C/RTL component tests and standalone XRT fixtures are not a fresh full native route with hardware-owned authority
